install.note: Use the official current installer. Windows requires Windows 11 and PowerShell. Linux requires glibc 2.34+ or the official compatible musl variant. Do not pin an obsolete release or substitute Crew's bundled CLI for the standalone installation.

install_flow.summary: Detect platform and existing CLI -> run the current official installer -> verify the executable and version.
agent_steps: Detect OS, architecture and existing kiro-cli first; do not reinstall a working CLI. Windows: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Kiro-Cli\kiro-cli.exe or %ProgramFiles%\Kiro-Cli\kiro-cli.exe, and the Kiro CLI MSI registration. macOS/Linux: ~/.local/bin/kiro-cli or the current native installation on PATH.

Windows 11: run install.windows_powershell in PowerShell with a hidden background window. The official script selects the supported architecture and current signed package. Check its exit status; do not silently change shell execution policy or install an unsupported build. If elevation or an interactive installer remains required, report that step.

macOS/Linux: run the official install.macos_curl or install.linux_curl command in the user's shell. Let the installer select the supported architecture. Check its exit status and any platform prerequisite message. Never run a package for a different architecture.

Refresh EchoBird detection and verify the full kiro-cli path with --version. Preserve user settings, conversations and native credentials. EchoBird launches kiro-cli chat through its normal terminal and project-directory flow.
